files.apparent_purpose: Historical UFPI graduation assistant system-prompt specification with tool/search examples. This is an instruction document, not corpus, structured gold, or an executable question dataset.

history.subject: Implement new user feedback mechanism for chatbot_ufpi and chatbot_ufpi_v2. This update introduces a system for collecting and analyzing user interactions, allowing for continuous improvement of chatbot responses and user experience. Enhanced logging features have also been added to track feedback effectively.

Add chatbot_ufpi_v2 agent for enhanced academic assistance. This version incorporates semantic and metadata search capabilities, allowing for more accurate responses based on the UFPI General Regulation of Graduation (RGG). Updated agent configuration to include the new chatbot and refined search tools for improved functionality.

reference_paths.excerpt: Origem: `data/questoes_para_avaliar_o_agente.md`, 20 perguntas e respostas. Padrão: linguagem cotidiana de aluno; perguntas diretas e condicionais; prazos, limites, listas e procedimentos; respostas curtas com condições; citações inconsistentes. Não há registro de amostragem, anotadores ou adjudicação no arquivo original. Sua mera existência não comprova revisão.
Os dois conjuntos são **candidatos a gold**, sem revisão independente registrada. O gabarito original da graduação permanece preservado em `data/questoes_para_avaliar_o_agente.md`.

history.subject: Refactor questions in the academic evaluation Markdown file for improved formatting and clarity. Adjusted indentation and spacing for consistency across all entries, ensuring a uniform presentation of information regarding UFPI's academic regulations.

Add a new Markdown file with a comprehensive list of questions and answers for evaluating students at UFPI. This resource aims to clarify academic regulations and procedures, enhancing the knowledge base for the chatbot_ufpi agent.
